Introduction
This document sets out the maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out annually as indicated above by the code Y1, and the initial draft was prepared from the documents previously prepared by the Holding Company for Electric Power Distribution, and the document was discussed, amended and then approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies at the session of 22 November 2005, and updated at the session of 17 March 2009.
Maintenance procedures are carried out to avoid sudden faults and to restore the efficiency of the disconnect switches to their normal condition according to the manufacturer's instructions, if any, taking into account the operating conditions and replacing and renewing the kiosk components that need to be changed to suit the operating conditions.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the place with a warning tape to define the work area, and post warning signs.
Follow occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, such as wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources and secured.
Ensure absence of voltage from the supply source using a tested voltage indicator.
Ensure portable earthing is applied to the contents of the kiosk and the cable ends to be worked on.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Occupational safety and health equipment.
Tested voltage indicator, portable earth.
A suitable set of tools and screwdrivers fit for work, and suitable grease.
Blower, cleaning brush and cloth pieces ('soft and clean').
Paint material for painting the kiosk, painting equipment and suitable cleaning materials.
Cable numbering and naming machine.
Occupational safety and health equipment.
Tested voltage indicator, portable earth.
A suitable set of tools and screwdrivers fit for work, and suitable grease.
Blower, cleaning brush and cloth pieces ('soft and clean').
Paint material for painting the kiosk, painting equipment and suitable cleaning materials.
Cable numbering and naming machine.
Procedures to be Carried Out
Check the tightening of all cable and disconnect switch terminals in the kiosk | 1.
Ensure the soundness of the end boxes if the cables are oil-filled | 2.
Inspect the insulators of the busbar and disconnect switch supports and ensure they are sound, replacing damaged ones | 3.
Check the disconnect switch mechanism and the soundness of its switching off and on | 4.
Grease the moving and fixed connection parts of the disconnect switches | 5.
Check the fuse rating on the disconnect switch, if any, and replace unsuitable ones | 6.
Seal the cable entry and exit openings in the kiosk | 7.
Ensure the busbars are insulated and numbered | 8.
Check the numbering and naming of the incoming and outgoing cables and disconnect switches, identifying the supply source and the outgoing direction | 9.
Check the earthing connected to the cables and the kiosk earthing | 10.
Check the soundness of the concrete floor of the kiosk, ensuring its height | 11.
Ensure a single-line diagram is present inside the kiosk, showing the current inlets and outlets | 12.
Check the kiosk maintenance card | 13.
Check the kiosk paint | 14.
Check the cleanliness of the whole kiosk | 15.
Check the secure closing of all doors of the kiosk or the ring main panel | 16.
